items.topic: Knowledge-gaps report scope: 324 validated gaps in 72 topics
items.claim: Gap mining output needs review before it becomes catalog content
items.fact: knowledge-gaps-report.md (openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/) lists 324 validated gaps in 72 topics from 60 read-only subagents on @free (mercury-3): 34 read judo-ng digests of 103 repos, 26 read condensed logs of 544 dev sessions; 420 candidates, 16 already in catalog, 79 internals/project-specific, 1 broken path rejected. Validation: 419/420 citations real; 10 platform claims checked in source were right; per-topic session counts are miners' own and may be inflated. Working files: target/gap-mining/all_gaps.json, verdicts.py.

items.topic: Top gaps: platform behaviour absent from agent-docs
items.fact: Missing: signed identifiers (change on every update, cannot be minted, need a stable secret), optimistic locking, REST contract, upload-token flow, which operations interceptors fire on, time zones; no JQL function reference and no JCL reference; UI-model values that break the generator; surprising DAO calls; production config: MUI license, Jasypt ENC() secrets, Keycloak login theme, S3/GCS filestore settings, CORS, local mail testing.

items.topic: Best-practices gaps: model change impact, DAO performance, server-side rule enforcement, e2e method, document templates
items.fact: Missing best-practices: how model changes break generated and custom frontend code; DAO performance; enforcing rules on the server, not only in the UI; end-to-end testing method; document template authoring. Also 7 rackinspect-derived domains (inspection fault-registry workflow, offer pricing, offline mobile ingest) need generalising before becoming model-blueprints (one project, two developers).

items.topic: Generated relation-setter DAOs NPE on null relatedObject
items.claim: Gap S01-06: generated relation-setter DAOs throw NPE when relatedObject is null
items.fact: Generated DAO/SDK relation setters should handle null relatedObject (e.g. clear relation) instead of NPE; reviewer marked it 'check against current judo-ng SDK generator before writing' (still unverified).

items.topic: Out-of-stack topics need operator scope decision
items.claim: JSL, Spring Boot and Flutter gaps
items.fact: Three topics only matter if catalog covers that stack; current catalog is ESM, Karaf, React. Agent proposes the CLI gaps be owned by the judo-model-cli skill with the catalog linking to it. Operator decision pending.

items.claim: Operator request: human-readable website from the md file
items.fact: Operator wants a review website: all md files listed and openable in Zed, per-modification decision (accept/needs change/defer/reject) and notes saved immediately and editable, always-visible way to add missing items. Built as target/review-app/server.py (stdlib Python, port 8791, binds 0.0.0.0 for LAN) + index.html; state in openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/review-state.json; export to review-decisions.md.

items.topic: Zed buttons open file, not exact line
items.fact: Operator: 'not exact line we can just open the whole md page in zed' (later reversed: wants jump to the part).

items.topic: '+' must add a new TOPIC not a suggestion
items.claim: Agent implemented + as 'add suggestion' to a topic
items.fact: Operator: 'I meant add a new topic not a suggestion! we should be able to add a short one liner with a sentence of new topic that is missing'. Always-visible sidebar form: one-line title + one sentence + target (agent-docs, best-practices, model-blueprints, other).

items.topic: New topics go to separate missing-topics.md, never into knowledge-gaps-report.md
items.claim: New topics were stored in review-state.json
items.fact: Operator: app must NOT write into knowledge gaps report but into a new file of missing parts, which developers will extend by hand. missing-topics.md format: '## <one-line topic>' heading, one sentence, optional '- **Target:**', '- **Decision:**', '- **Proposed by:**', '- **Added:**', '**Notes:**' paragraph, hidden '<!-- id: new:xxxx -->' comment. App reads hand edits; reloads on tab focus. Zed buttons must jump to the section/heading.

items.topic: Zed CLI cannot open markdown preview; simulate keystrokes
items.claim: Operator asked: open in preview mode directly and jump to it
items.fact: Zed 1.27.0 CLI (`zed path:line:col`) has no preview flag. Workaround: open file at line then press Zed's preview shortcut (cmd-k v = preview beside source, cmd-shift-v = preview only) via OS keystrokes; needs macOS Accessibility permission for the terminal/pi running the server; keys configurable in PREVIEW_KEYS in server.py; preview-only scroll-to-section unverified. Actions: markdown::OpenPreview, markdown::OpenPreviewToTheSide.

items.topic: Make domain knowledge part and subcategory big and readable
items.claim: Part/area shown as small grey trailer
items.fact: Operator: part (agent-docs/best-practices/model-blueprints) and area (backend, model, domain…) must be bigger and more readable. Implemented as colour-coded tag chips (.tag.part-*, .tag.area) on topic header and each card. All 72 topics got a part+area; distribution: agent-docs/model 13, backend 11, deployment 8, frontend 7, model-blueprints/domain 7, testing 4.

Operator asked to serve on LAN. Server now binds 0.0.0.0 by default (python3 target/review-app/server.py [port] [host]; pass 127.0.0.1 for local only); LAN URL http://172.28.1.16:8791/. Caveat: state is shared, last save wins; Zed buttons open Zed on the host Mac only, others use the View button. macOS firewall was disabled; python3.9 incoming permitted.

items.topic: Local port 8765 occupied by another mockup server; use 8791
items.fact: Port 8765 is taken on the operator machine; review app uses 8791. Python `markdown` module is not installed (system python 3.9), so use stdlib-only scripts.

items.claim: Raw curl output is blocked; kb guard nags on repeated source searches
items.fact: Inline `curl -s URL` to stdout is blocked by a context-mode hook; use `curl -s -o /tmp/x.json URL` then read file. A kb guard says 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult' and wants kb_search / kb agents <path> / kb get before more greps. agent-browser: confirm() dialogs block the page (use `dialog accept|dismiss`); `find text` and selectors with ':' in ids fail, use eval with document.querySelector; changing only the #hash does not reload (use reload or ?v=N).
